description.en: TraceJudgeBench is a diagnostic benchmark for auditing citation-like artifacts in RAG and agent-workflow evaluation, covering content-equivalent pairs, citation ablations, correctness conflicts, quality gaps, prompt-strength ladders, decoupled judging, and a workflow-ranking probe.
